name: 91423 · Sherman Oaks, CA
findings: ZIP 91423 (Sherman Oaks) has 189 nonprofit organizations. 65 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 50 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 91423 (Sherman Oaks) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
